# Original HLSL fixture

`random.hlsl` is the unchanged 1021-byte `src/shaders/random.hlsl` from `clshortfuse/renodx` revision `8323b471d0ad5faa104fb4d62befe77d2e0a3ab4`. Its SHA-256 is `b7e3e1e0560a3b3d2a788ca5e2bc530d68e29979d93c7fa3a7f7676eb8d0ad3f`. The original MIT license remains in `LICENSE.md`.

The native own-parameter subset preserves the exact written `Generate.uv` and `Hash33.p3` owners. The argument at 476..478 proves a binding Reference; the binary operand at 628..630 proves a value Read. Intrinsic calls, constructors, swizzles, branch selection and complete body semantics remain unqualified.
